attribution: Google FLEURS ar_eg test, CC BY 4.0. Error counts derived from human references and model predictions; text and audio are not included.
source_counts: The frozen per-clip records from the eight published native runs. Every normalized count was rescored from its saved public reference and hypothesis; every aggregate was checked against the published report.
strict_counts: Rescored without Alef/Yaa folding using the original normalization and RapidFuzz 3.14.6; every resulting aggregate matches the published report.

csv_columns.run: Identifier from the accuracy section of the published benchmark JSON.
csv_columns.clip_id: Public FLEURS audio filename stem, not a private timing-recording identifier.
csv_columns.sentence_id: Public reference-sentence cluster ID; keep it as a string for the original lexicographic bootstrap order.
csv_columns.strict_*: Counts without Alef/Yaa folding; reference and hypothesis lengths match the primary normalization.
csv_columns.same_as_original: 1 when this normalized output equals the original output for this model/segmentation, 0 otherwise; original rows equal themselves.

bootstrap.sampling: Paired reference-sentence clusters, with replacement. Include every clip in each selected cluster. Use sum(errors)/sum(reference words), not the mean of clip rates.
bootstrap.quantiles: Sorted samples at zero-based floor(0.025*n) and floor(0.975*n); no interpolation.

limitations: Each setting is one inference pass; each CSV row is one clip within that pass. Bootstrap intervals cover reference-sentence sampling only, not GPU run-to-run variation. The counts reproduce published statistics but cannot replace audio, reference text, predictions and an inference rerun.
